Name: Fill Chest - Item Duplicator
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
One Item → Full Chest
[heading]Description[/heading]
Ever wished you could fill an entire chest with one item instantly?
[b]One Item → Full Chest[/b] is a simple item duplication cheat that lets you turn a single item into a fully stocked chest with one key press.
Place the item you want to duplicate in the [b]first slot of a chest[/b], make sure every other slot is empty, and press [b]F7[/b]. The mod fills the entire chest with that item using its actual maximum stack size.
Perfect for testing, building, creative play, or simply saving time.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Fill an entire chest with one key press [/*]
[*]Uses the item's actual maximum stack size [/*]
[*]Supports different chest capacities [/*]
[*]Works with stackable and non-stackable items [/*]
[*]Preserves item properties [/*]
[*]Simple and lightweight [/*]
[*]Fully configurable hotkey through GMCM [/*]
[/list][heading]Safety Check[/heading]
The mod will [b]never overwrite existing items[/b].
Before filling the chest, it checks every slot after the first one.
If any other slot contains an item, the operation is cancelled and a warning is displayed.
[quote][b]Chest must be empty except for the first slot.[/b][/quote]Nothing is moved, deleted, or overwritten.
[heading]How to Use[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Open a supported chest. [/*]
[*]Place [b]one item in the first slot[/b]. [/*]
[*]Make sure all remaining slots are empty. [/*]
[*]Press [b]F7[/b]. [/*]
[*]The entire chest is filled with that item. [/*]
[/list]Example:
[code]Wood ×1[/code]→ [b]F7[/b] →
[code]Wood ×999[/code]in every available slot.
[heading]Controls[/heading]
[b]Default key:[/b]
[code]F7[/code]The hotkey can be changed using [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b].
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ [/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.5.1+ [/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu [i](optional)[/i] [/*]
[/list]No Content Patcher or other frameworks are required.
[heading]Important[/heading]
This mod intentionally duplicates items and is designed as a [b]cheat/QoL tool[/b]. Use it according to how you want to play.
[b]One item. One key. Full chest.[/b]
